description:
Configure a chart for professional publication by creating a high-contrast 'White Mode' style. 

Starting from the NinjaTrader Control Center:
1. Open a new Daily chart for SPY.
2. Configure the Chart Properties to be 'Print-Ready':
   - Set the Chart Background to White.
   - Ensure Axis text/labels are readable (e.g., Black).
   - Hide the Grid Lines or make them Transparent.
3. Add an SMA (Simple Moving Average) indicator with Period 50.
4. Change the SMA plot color to Dark Blue (or any distinct Blue) so it stands out against the white background.
5. Save this configuration as a Chart Template named 'PrintReady'.
6. Export an image of the chart as a PNG file to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\SPY_Report.png'.
